purpose: Independent check that data/raw/chirps3/<ward>.pixels.csv really is CHIRPS v3.0 at the right pixels. CHIRPS v3 daily is a split of the CHIRPS v3 pentad totals, and the pentads in a month sum to the CHIRPS v3 monthly total. So the sum of each cached daily pixel over a month must equal the separately published CHIRPS v3.0 monthly GeoTIFF at the same pixel centre. Three months were checked: April 1984 (early record, where v3 is much wetter than v2), November 2022 (where v3 has about twice the v2 total) and September 2026 (the last cached month).
result: All 24 pixel-months (2 wards x 4 pixels x 3 months) match: the monthly GeoTIFF value equals the sum of the cached daily values to 0.01 mm (rounding). The pixel order and positions in <ward>.meta.json are therefore right, and the cached daily series is CHIRPS v3.0.

request.grid: Africa, 1500 x 1600, 0.05 deg, origin 20W 40N, float32 mm per month
request.pixels: the pixel centres listed in data/raw/chirps3/<ward>.meta.json, in that order
request.file_note: The three GeoTIFFs (about 5 MB each) are not committed; only the values used are kept here. Re-download and compare the SHA-256 above to repeat the check.
